description: Persist the running narration of a live VJ/show set so decisions can be recalled afterwards. mode='append' adds a timestamped line (with optional section + cue) to a markdown session log (default ~/.tdmcp/narration-<date>.md); mode='recall' reads the log back (last `tail` lines). Pair with the auto_vj_director prompt: instead of narrating only in chat, call narrate_set on each major move so the set leaves a diary/setlist trail. Writes a local file (not read-only). Delta vs log_performance, which writes a one-shot network snapshot rather than an append-only decision log.

cue.description: Optional cue name being fired/recalled, for cross-reference.

line.description: The narration line to record (required for mode='append'), e.g. "holding through the build → cue 'drop' on the next bar".

log_path.description: Explicit path to the narration log file, overriding set_name. Honors TDMCP_NARRATION_PATH otherwise.

mode.description: append: add a narration line to the running set log. recall: read back the log lines.

section.description: Optional song section/phase this line belongs to, e.g. 'intro', 'drop', 'breakdown'.

set_name.description: Session name; picks the log file ~/.tdmcp/narration-<set_name>.md. Defaults to today's date.

tail.description: For mode='recall': return at most the last N narration lines.

name: narrate_set

count.description: Total narration lines in the log.

log_path.description: Absolute path of the narration log file.

title: Narrate a live set (persisted decision log)
